name: manual_2b934c
claim: An agent-surface security scan fails a skills script that opens a credential file (error-level SC-EX-001). Do not baseline, obfuscate or disable the rule: remove the behavior. Read settings from the process environment, forward only an allowlist to the child process, and document how the operator exports them.

decisions.notes: lan_peer_send.py loaded an env file itself and failed the PR; reading the environment only, with an allowlist for the child, cleared it with zero new findings against main.
